headline: Vendor booths
lead: Food trucks, open cooking, drinks, snacks, craft and merchant booths, and nonprofit info tables for Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết 2027.

meta.description: Join the vendor booth waitlist and learn the two-round application process for Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết 2027 — apply, selection, offer, pay, or waitlist / decline.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.body: Full booth applications are not open yet. Earliest target: October 2026. Join the waitlist so we can email you when Eventeny opens — returning 2026 vendors will also get a direct note.

cta.label: Join the vendor waitlist
cta.note: Placement is not guaranteed — this list helps us plan outreach when registration opens.

timeline.title: How selection works
timeline.intro: We run a **two-round** process so early applicants can lock a seat with certainty, while we still hold room for strong late applications. The path is the same in both rounds.

rounds.label: Round 1 — Priority
rounds.note: Most seats (~70–80%). Decisions around Oct 30. Selected vendors pay by Nov 13 to lock the booth. Miss that pay-by and you move to the Round 2 selection waitlist.

rounds.label: Round 2 — Open
rounds.note: Remaining seats (~20–30%) plus any Round 1 seats that don’t pay on time. Decisions around Jan 22 — including waitlisted Round 1 selectees. Pay by Jan 29.

timeline.pathIntro: Every applicant waits for a decision batch. From there the path branches:

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Submit through Eventeny when applications open (deposit required to be considered).

steps.title: Wait for selection
steps.body: We review the round’s pool together — not first-come, first-served. Food booths are ranked for menu fit; other booths by staff fit.

steps.title: Decision
steps.body: You’ll land on one of three outcomes.

outcomes.title: Offer sent
outcomes.body: You’re selected. Accept the offer (food vendors may get a recommended festival menu), then **pay the booth fee by the pay-by date**.
outcomes.next: Once paid, you’re officially part of the festival — seat locked.

outcomes.title: Selection waitlist
outcomes.body: You’re a ranked runner-up for that lane — **or** you were selected in Round 1 but didn’t pay by Nov 13. Unpaid Round 1 selectees are moved here automatically and **must wait for Round 2 decisions** (around Jan 22).
outcomes.next: A waitlist spot is not a reserved booth until you receive an offer and pay.

outcomes.title: Declined
outcomes.body: Not selected for this festival season. Apply deposits are refunded on reject.

steps.title: Pay → official vendor
steps.body: Selection holds only through the pay-by date. Pay on time and you’re on the map. **Miss Round 1’s pay-by** and you’re placed on the **Round 2 selection waitlist** — you wait for the Round 2 decision batch; that seat goes back into Round 2 inventory.

timeline.footnote: Dates are planning targets published for vendors. Exact seat counts by booth type post after park capacity is confirmed.
